Considering all these aspects, the uncertainly in the mass estimate could be a factor of a few.

referee_caveats_inferred: The preferred kinematic interpretation rests on qualitative P-V morphology; no quantitative model-selection statistic or parameter confidence region is supplied.
Inclination, central mass and infall are coupled; the 4.76–4.8 M☉ kinematic model mass should not be treated as an independent stellar-mass measurement.
The <125 au disc radius is a resolution-based conditional limit, rather than a detected disc size.
Optically thick and blended lines make the unspecified treatment of contaminated channels important for reproducing temperature and column-density maps.
The text reports observed FWHM near 8 km s^-1 but a fitting linewidth range of 3–6 km s^-1 without explicitly defining the fitted linewidth convention.
Simulation timing is internally inconsistent: a 40.0 kyr run is followed by an output described as 18.52 Myr after collapse and bursts at 17–23 Myr.
The temporal discussion refers to a 2017 Sep epoch, while the observing section lists 2017 July 20 and the main analysis uses 2016 September.
Ignoring interferometric filtering in synthetic cubes is justified by source extent, but no visibility-domain recovery test is reported.
